info.title: jobNshop Marketplace API
info.description:
# Getting started

1. Create an account with **POST /v1/auth/signup**.
2. Log in with **POST /v1/auth/login** and copy the returned JWT.
3. Select **Authorize** in Swagger UI and enter the token (Swagger adds the Bearer prefix).
4. Browse or create services, hiring requirements, or products.
5. Use bookings, proposals, cart and checkout, bids, chat, reviews, sharing, and boosts as applicable.

All /v1 endpoints except signup, login, and password recovery require a bearer JWT backed by an active session. Amounts are PKR. Media uploads use raw base64 inside JSON, not multipart forms. Prices and bid amounts are returned as decimal strings by PostgreSQL. The production server URL below is read from frontend/.env.local; availability and deployed version are separate from this local contract.

post.description: Create an account, then log in.

password.description: Uppercase, lowercase, digit; maximum 72 UTF-8 bytes

post.description: Returns JWT in the JSON body and Authorization response header. Use Authorize in Swagger UI.
Emails a six digit reset code valid for 20 minutes; response does not disclose whether an account exists.
Original price must be at least the selling price. Media is raw base64 JSON.
Cannot book your own service or have duplicate pending bookings.

put.description: Send all listing fields. Omit media to keep it, or send null to remove it.

delete.description: Listings with booking history must be changed to Draft instead.

post.description: Up to 3 attachments, 8 MB each and 16 MB total. Voice is separate.

put.description: Omit media to retain it. Awarded requirements cannot be edited.

post.description: One proposal per worker on an open requirement.
Active products need an image and positive stock.
Checks stock, creates one order per product, and clears the cart. Cash payment is arranged with sellers.

openingPrice.description: PKR decimal amount, maximum two fractional digits

post.description: Bid must exceed opening price or current highest bid. Owners cannot bid on their own products.

amount.description: PKR decimal amount, maximum two fractional digits

put.description: Send all listing fields. Omit media to keep it, or send null to remove it.

delete.description: Listings with order or bid history must be changed to Draft instead.

post.description: Server derives both participants from the listing or transaction.

get.description: Up to 50 messages per page, chronological order; use before cursor for earlier messages.

delete.description: Only hides existing history for the current user.
Removes a sent message for both participants.

put.description: Owned listing must be published. Budget is stored for ranking; no payment is collected.

get.description: Returns up to 100 reviews and the overall rating. Only the owner or a previous reviewer can view an inactive listing.

put.description: Creates or updates the signed-in member review of an active listing. Owners cannot review their own listings. Rating must be 1 to 5; body must be 10 to 1000 characters.

delete.description: Deletes the signed-in member review for this listing. Returns 404 if that member has not reviewed it.

get.description: Returns the highest active daily boost budget among up to 30 recent live listings of this type, excluding the signed-in member. The benchmark is null when no matching boost exists.

city.description: Service city. Optional for existing API clients; the mobile service form requires it.
